import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import *

def doc(cases, events, channels, definitions=None, timeout_ms=10, seed='s'):
    return {'seed': seed, 'definitions': definitions or [], 'timeout_ms': timeout_ms,
            'cases': cases, 'events': events, 'channels': channels}

def case(name, frames=None, method='GET', target='/a', host='h'):
    return {'name': name, 'frames': frames or [],
            'expect': {'method': method, 'target': target, 'host': host}}

def hf(pairs, end=True):
    return {'Type': 'headers', 'data_to_transfered': [[k, v] for k, v in pairs], 'End_Stream': end}

def chan(name, parts):
    return {'name': name, 'parts': [{'case': o, 'data': d} for o, d in parts]}

REQ_OK = "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n"

# ---- A. chunked request with trailer ----------------------------------
data = ("POST /u HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: A\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n"
        "5;xx\r\nhello\r\n6\r\n world\r\n0\r\nX-T: v\r\n\r\n")
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])], method='POST', target='/u', host='A')],
                [], [chan('z', [('c', data)])]))
rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
hdrs = [("Host", "A"), ("Transfer-Encoding", "chunked")]
check('chunked request span', rec['start'] == 0 and rec['end'] == len(data))
check('chunked method/target', rec['method'] == fp(b'POST') and rec['target'] == fp(b'/u'))
check('chunked host', rec['host'] == fp(b'a') and rec['host_count'] == 1)
check('chunked headers', rec['headers'] == fp(enc_pairs([(n.encode(), v.encode()) for n, v in hdrs])), rec['headers'])
check('chunked body', rec['body'] == fp(b'hello world'), rec['body'])
check('chunked trailers', rec['trailers'] == fp(enc_pairs([(b'X-T', b'v')])), rec['trailers'])
check('chunked framing/owner', rec['framing'] == 'chunked' and rec['owner'] == 'c')
check('chunked owners', rec['owners'] == [['c', len(data)]])
check('chunked flags', rec['flags'] == [])
check('chunked channel', r['channels'][0]['bytes'] == fp(data.encode()) and
      r['channels'][0]['committed'] == [1] and r['channels'][0]['error'] is None)
check('chunked request keys', set(rec) == {'start','end','method','target','host','host_count',
      'headers','body','trailers','framing','owner','owners','flags'})
check('chunked channel keys', set(r['channels'][0]) == {'name','bytes','requests','committed','error'})
check('chunked case', r['cases'][0]['origin_count'] == 1 and r['cases'][0]['flags'] == [])

# ---- C. Content-Length / Transfer-Encoding rules -----------------------
def framing_of(header_block):
    body = data_probe = "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\n" + header_block + "\r\n"
    r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])])], [], [chan('z', [('c', body)])]))
    ch = r['channels'][0]
    if ch['error'] is None:
        return ('ok', ch['requests'][0]['framing'], ch['requests'][0]['body'])
    return (ch['error']['kind'], None, None)

check('CL list same', framing_of("Content-Length: 5,5\r\n") == ('ok', 'length', None) or True)
res = framing_of("Content-Length: 5,5\r\n")
check('CL 5,5', res[0] == 'ok' and res[1] == 'length', res)
res = framing_of("Content-Length: 5, 5 \r\n")
check('CL trimmed list', res[0] == 'ok' and res[1] == 'length', res)
res = framing_of("Content-Length: 05\r\n")
check('CL leading zeros', res[0] == 'ok' and res[1] == 'length', res)
res = framing_of("Content-Length: 5,6\r\n")
check('CL conflict values', res[0] == 'syntax', res)
res = framing_of("Content-Length: 5\r\nContent-Length: 5\r\n")
check('CL two occurrences same', res[0] == 'ok' and res[1] == 'length', res)
res = framing_of("Content-Length: 5\r\nContent-Length: 6\r\n")
check('CL two occurrences differ', res[0] == 'syntax', res)
res = framing_of("Content-Length:\r\n")
check('CL empty', res[0] == 'syntax', res)
res = framing_of("Content-Length: ,\r\n")
check('CL empty members', res[0] == 'syntax', res)
res = framing_of("Content-Length: 5,\r\n")
check('CL trailing comma', res[0] == 'syntax', res)
res = framing_of("Content-Length: +5\r\n")
check('CL signed', res[0] == 'syntax', res)
res = framing_of("Content-Length: 5x\r\n")
check('CL junk', res[0] == 'syntax', res)
res = framing_of("Content-Length: 9223372036854775808\r\n")
check('CL too large', res[0] == 'syntax', res)
res = framing_of("Content-Length: 9223372036854775807\r\n")
check('CL max ok', res[0] == 'incomplete', res)   # body never sent -> incomplete
res = framing_of("Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n")
check('TE chunked', res[0] == 'ok' and res[1] == 'chunked', res)
res = framing_of("Transfer-Encoding: Chunked \r\n")
check('TE case/trim', res[0] == 'ok' and res[1] == 'chunked', res)
res = framing_of("transfer-encoding:chunked\r\n")
check('TE lowercase', res[0] == 'ok' and res[1] == 'chunked', res)
res = framing_of("Transfer-Encoding: chunked, chunked\r\n")
check('TE list', res[0] == 'syntax', res)
res = framing_of("Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n")
check('TE twice', res[0] == 'syntax', res)
res = framing_of("Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n")
check('TE with CL', res[0] == 'syntax', res)
res = framing_of("Content-Length: 0\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n")
check('CL with TE', res[0] == 'syntax', res)
res = framing_of("Transfer-Encoding: gzip\r\n")
check('TE other', res[0] == 'syntax', res)
res = framing_of("")
check('no framing zero body', res[0] == 'ok' and res[1] == 'none' and res[2] == fp(b''), res)

# ---- request/target line rules -----------------------------------------
def reqline(line):
    r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])])], [], [chan('z', [(None, line)])]))
    err = r['channels'][0]['error']
    return err['kind'] if err else 'ok'

check('plain request line', reqline("GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n") == 'ok')
check('lowercase method', reqline("get /a HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n") == 'ok')
check('target visible', reqline("GET /a?x=1:2%3 HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n") == 'ok')
check('bad version', reqline("GET /a HTTP/1.2\r\n\r\n") == 'syntax')
check('double space', reqline("GET  /a HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n") == 'syntax')
check('trailing extra', reqline("GET /a HTTP/1.1 x\r\n\r\n") == 'syntax')
check('tab in target', reqline("GET /a\tb HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n") == 'syntax')
check('empty target', reqline("GET  HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n") == 'syntax')
check('bad method char', reqline("G/ET /a HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n") == 'syntax')
check('space before colon', reqline("GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nX : y\r\n\r\n") == 'syntax')
check('header no colon', reqline("GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nXY\r\n\r\n") == 'syntax')
check('header ctrl char', reqline("GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nX:\x01\r\n\r\n") == 'syntax')
check('header tab value ok', reqline("GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nX: a\tb \r\n\r\n") == 'ok')
check('bare LF line', reqline("GET /a HTTP/1.1\n") == 'syntax')
check('bare CR', reqline("GET /a HTTP/1.1\rX\r\n\r\n") == 'syntax')

# header trimming preserved in headers fp
r = run_obj(doc([case('c', [hf([('x','y')])])], [],
                [chan('z', [(None, "GET /a HTTP/1.1\r\nX:  a\tb  \r\n\r\n")])]))
rec = r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]
check('header value trimmed', rec['headers'] == fp(enc_pairs([(b'X', b'a\tb')])), rec['headers'])

summary()
EOF
